title: Slow cooker chicken and sausage jambalaya
prep: about 12 min in the morning, 10 min at dinner
equipment: 6 to 7 qt slow cooker, rice cooker
ingredients: 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, whole
1 1/2 Tbsp Cajun seasoning (use 1 Tbsp for milder)

steps.do: Morning, by 9:00 am: put the celery, onion, peppers and garlic in the slow cooker. Lay the chicken thighs and sausage on top, sprinkle with the Cajun seasoning and thyme, and pour the tomatoes and broth over. Cook on low 7 to 8 hours.
About 35 min before dinner, start the rice in the rice cooker.
Shred the chicken with two forks right in the pot and stir. Serve over (or stirred into) the rice.

changes: Chicken thighs raised to 3 lb (recipe uses 2 thighs) for 40g+ protein; vegetables and tomatoes 1.5x.
Rice cooked in the rice cooker instead of in the slow cooker (more reliable at this size), so less broth.
Pantry Cajun seasoning instead of measuring oregano, paprika, cayenne and pepper; mild smoked sausage, no shrimp.
Your frozen celery and onion; dried garlic; parsley and green onion garnish skipped.
